message.content: Based on the conversation, ChaeSong-hwa plans to bring snacks to the karaoke night. This is indicated in the last message from ChaeSong-hwa, who says, "I’ll bring some snacks too. See you all Friday! 🎤🍕✨" Additionally, during their initial discussion about the karaoke night, LiHua asks ChaeSong-hwa if he'll be bringing anything, to which ChaeSong-hwa responds, "I'm excited to bring some snacks too." This shows that snacks are part of what ChaeSong-hwa intends to bring to the event.
